fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Aries Season, Gemini Moons, and Jupiter", "body": "Michael Nnebe Jr. said he had been returning to himself this Aries season and learning to use Aries energy without misusing it, while Chance said spring felt like the truer moment for new starts than January. Asked about the moon in Gemini, Michael described each 28 day revisit as a firmware update for the mind and compared transits to weather that every natal chart felt differently. Later he said Jupiter was due to enter Aries in May and to return as Capricorn season began, which he called a restart after twelve years of growth."}, {"title": "Archangel Stars and Planetary Alien Constructs", "body": "Michael walked through fixed stars he tied to archangels, naming Aldebaran, Regulus and Antares, and said Antares was the Uriel star. He claimed that some birth charts and even names lined up with those archangels. Chance said he knew the four royal stars but had never thought of them that way. Michael also described alien constructs from an article he shared on screen, saying outer planets on the sun, moon or rising made power, vessel or instrument aliens. Chance preferred the word pantheon, and Michael agreed that was more accurate."}, {"title": "Channeling, Source, and Making It Up", "body": "Michael said he learned the planets by talking to them as if they were homies, and that early skepticism about channeling and imposter feelings gave way once real people confirmed what he sensed. Chance argued that source is pure imagination, so making it up as you go is the right path when intent matches the highest good, and Michael added that integrity keeps it from becoming lies. Michael also said he had come to believe everyone and everything was perfect, and Chance replied that perceived imperfection marks the direction life wants to flow."}, {"title": "Conspirituality and Hidden Forces", "body": "Chance said conspiracy research and spiritual development lead into each other, and that decoding headlines through gematria hinted at forces beyond ordinary human planning. Michael said unseen spiritual forces orchestrated events from a higher level, that people erred by explaining them with conventional logic, and he cited Ephesians 6:12 to argue the real struggle was not against other people. Chance theorized that adepts of mystery traditions might meet in an astral temple. Near the end, Michael argued that mythology was encoded through symbolism for predictive programming, and Chance suggested the dark forces might be servitors people once created themselves."}, {"title": "Twin Flame Readings and the Elemental Card Pull", "body": "Answering a question from a caller, Michael said tarot readers who specialized in twin flame and love readings often drew in hopeless romantics, that some of those readings were accurate, but that accuracy did not make the practice right, and he called much of the energy behind it scammy. He added that he had fallen for it himself and had to mature out of it. The conversation then turned to a card game in which the group drew an I Ching hexagram or tarot card for fire, earth, air and water, then one more for the avatar who unites all four."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The illustriously adept astrologer & virtuoso of all things Tarot, Michael Nnebe Jr., aka The Peace Dealer, joins Vibe Rant tonight for a fun infused chat on the current opportunities & challenges in the sky-clock this Aries season.
